title: Tributary engine Kafka connection, v0
description: How one data-plane process (receiver, pipeline worker, loader, archiver) connects to THIS engine's own Kafka cluster: bootstrap servers plus transport security and the principal's credentials by secretRef. One document per process, mounted as a file and named by the TB_ENGINE_KAFKA_FILE environment variable. It carries no secret value and no librdkafka property: the client settings invariants 1, 4 and 5 depend on come from contracts/topics/v0 topic-defaults.json and cannot be overridden here. Contract set 1.3 (2026-09-29), ADR-008. See README.md.
$comment: additionalProperties false at every level, as in the channel spec. In particular there is NO passthrough of librdkafka properties: a free-form map merged into the client config is how acks=all or enable.idempotence=true gets silently overridden (the defect this contract closes in tributary.runtime.clients.KafkaSettings, ADR-008 D4).

bootstrapServers.$comment: The engine cluster. Replaces the per-role inputs --bootstrap and TB_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS, which are retired (README 3): bootstrap servers and security live in ONE document so the loopback rule below is checked against both at once. The e3ddee1 finding was the two living in different places.

allOf.$comment: PLAINTEXT only when every bootstrap server is loopback (topics/v0 3.4). A Docker Compose service name, a Kubernetes service or pod address and host.docker.internal are NOT loopback: traffic to them crosses a network interface other than lo.

loopbackHostPort.$comment: Same grammar as channel-spec/v0 $defs/loopbackHostPort and the runtime's LOOPBACK_HOST_PORT.

secretRef.$comment: Resolved from local files at process start (<TB_SECRETS_DIR>/<ref>/<key>, the DirSecretResolver convention), never through the control-plane API or PostgreSQL: invariant 3.

security.$comment: The channel-spec kafkaSecurity shape, tightened for the engine link: SSL must carry a client certificate, because an engine connection without a principal cannot be authorized by the per-component ACLs of topics/v0 3.4. No tls.minVersion: librdkafka cannot enforce one, so the cipher pin in README 4 is the floor.

saslMechanism.$comment: topics/v0 3.4 also permits OAUTHBEARER. It is not in v0 because nothing implements it; adding it is additive.

secretRef.$comment: The principal's identity, everything about how this process authenticates: keys `username` and `password` for SASL_SSL; `tls.crt` and `tls.key` for SSL (mTLS). The same layout both Kafka connector implementations already use (README 5).

tls.$comment: Broker certificate and hostname verification are always on and there is no field that turns them off. secretRef names the trust bundle ONLY (key `ca.crt`); absent means the platform trust store. A client certificate is security.secretRef, never here.
